Official

Overview

The Official is a Khadaganian official who becomes separated from the expedition on Gipath. Estera finds him while gathering herbs. He directs Zak to the expedition commander, describing the journey as an opportunity for a friendly meeting; the reception Zak actually receives is very different. [1, 2]

The expedition and the Hermit’s bargain

Estera introduces a lost Khadaganian official, who promises that his expedition can help Zak leave Gipath. Meeting Expedition commander instead leads to imprisonment and demands for information about a meteorite. Zak plays the ignorant swineherd, but the commander threatens torture. Hermit lizard offers escape on the condition that Zak later visit his home. Zak gives his word, receives the Ancient Claw for the traps on the approach and escapes. The Hermit explains that he had intended to negotiate with the armoured humans but changed his mind after seeing their treatment of Zak. Keeping the promise establishes trust where the expedition failed to do so. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
